notes:
Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); no hardware was attached or run, and this package is model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by null). The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver decision matches the upstream: R1Base-v0 is registered at galaxea_sim/envs/base/__init__.py:7-15 to galaxea_sim.envs.base.bimanual_manipulation:BimanualManipulationEnv (class at line 13), which is the driver's native and the first card entry symbol; no deviation from the card. The gate cannot import the clone (Sapien, CUDA, robot assets), so fake.py is this package's kinematic F0 stand-in for reset/step/close; it copies commanded joint targets into the observation and models no physics, contacts, controller, sensors or cameras. The upstream Sapien environment and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) were not run and nothing here was compared with an upstream run. NOT COVERED: the camera rgb_* and depth_* image arrays; the driver configures obs_mode='state' (the upstream default is image), and the real R1 arrays are 1280x720 for the head and 320x240 for each wrist (galaxea_sim/robots/r1.py:55-90), as recorded in the fidelity gaps. The fidelity timestep_ms is 10 ms (the constructor's physics timestep); one cap.world.step tick is one upstream control step, which runs decimation = 6 scene steps of 10 ms = 60 ms, and the Gymnasium bridge has no separate control-period field (FID-015), so this is stated in the gaps. reset(seed) and cap.world.seed.v1 accept and record a seed, but the upstream reset does not use it (bimanual_manipulation.py:159-164); the fake starts from a fixed placeholder state, and test_driver.py checks that the same actions repeat the state hashes. The clone states no finite action bound: the controller's Box is low=-inf, high=inf (bimanual_joint_position.py:42), so the driver declares no Limit and no operator_required bound (a simulator at R0 has nothing to bound; inventing one would be wrong). Warnings, all non-failing: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset), G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, seed (reset and seed class) and action.values inputs, and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because there is no finite limit to probe. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. The clone LICENSE is Apache-2.0 and matches the card, although README.md:17 and README.md:234 still say MIT. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
